about: Every statement a store sends as SQL text and not as a statement tree, with why it cannot be a tree. scripts/batch-lint.py classifies a store's raw batches from this list, scripts/fragment-lint.py and scripts/clock-lint.py still scan this text, and packages/conformance/test/text-statements.test.ts holds every store to it.

expire-lease-now.why: it may change one column of a run, which the poison matrix holds it to (leaseOnlyShortened), and a compare-and-set must also write the run's provenance

driver-heartbeat.why: it writes drivers, which carries no provenance, and each dialect writes it its own way: PostgreSQL as a common table expression that inserts and then deletes, MySQL as two statements with an optimizer hint and a locking read, libSQL as an insert into a view

migrate:bootstrap.why: it is DDL, which no statement tree holds, and a migration's text is frozen by its content hash

migrate:v*.why: it is DDL, which no statement tree holds, and a migration's text is frozen by its content hash

migrate:version.why: it reads meta before any schema may exist, and a missing table must surface as the executor's own typed error

admin:set-fake-now.why: it writes meta, which carries no provenance, so no compare-and-set can hold it

admin:clear-fake-now.why: it writes meta, which carries no provenance, so no compare-and-set can hold it

admin:now.why: it is the test clock's read of the clock definition itself, by an admin built over a bare executor with no tree dialect
